description: This source file defines an interface 'StorelessUnivariateStatistic' for calculating univariate statistics in a streaming fashion without storing all sample data. It extends 'UnivariateStatistic' and includes methods for incrementally updating the statistic with new data values.

classes.name: StorelessUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An interface extending 'UnivariateStatistic' that provides methods for statistics that can be updated incrementally, suitable for streaming data.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Updates the internal state of the statistic with a new value.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Updates the internal state with an array of new values.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Updates the internal state with a portion of an array of new values, specified by start index and length.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the statistic.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of values that have been added.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the statistic.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the statistic with the same internal state.
